name: Zone S: The Toll Turnstile
read_aloud: Service door turnstile. Accepted: credits at posted fee, valid key, or forced entry.
narrator_line: Service door turnstile. Accepted: credits at posted fee, valid key, or forced entry.
layout: The same utility hall, now with a System turnstile bolted across the service door and a slot that says PLEASE INSERT CREDITS.

exits.name: The service door and the stairs beyond.

features.name: The door itself (key, tools, force or toll).
Force is loud: the boss and ushers follow.

quick_run.setup: A turnstile bolted across the service door says PLEASE INSERT CREDITS.
quick_run.decision: Pay the Detour Tax, pick the lock, force it, or take the stage instead?
quick_run.on_success: The gate opens to the stairs below.
quick_run.on_failure: Forcing it is loud and the Dean arrives.
quick_run.cut_short: One choice, one roll, one consequence.

loot.text: Toll at the door: cited at rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.detour_tax (the Detour Tax, a missed Stairwell key only). House idea (inspired); a missed key costs, never wipes.
